name: notifier
title: Notifier
description: Posts chosen site events to a chat webhook (Slack, Discord, Mattermost), keeps a log of what it sent, and sends a daily digest.
author: Joinery

settings.name: webhook_url
settings.label: Webhook URL
settings.help: The incoming-webhook address your chat service gave you (https://hooks.slack.com/... or https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...).

settings.name: site_label
settings.label: Name to post as
settings.help: Shown at the start of each message.

sections.text: Messages this plugin posted to your chat webhook, newest first. Each site event it was approved for is posted as it happens; a digest goes out each morning.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.help: Posted to the webhook as it is.
